major_cooldowns.name: Lunar Eclipse
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Enter Eclipse with a nearly full Astral Power bar and enough banked procs to dump every Ascendant Eclipses stack inside 4 GCDs, and never sit on 2 charges.
major_cooldowns.id_note: The in-game button is Eclipse (1239669); logs record the cast as Lunar Eclipse 1233272 or Solar Eclipse 1233346, and only 1233272 appears in the sampled parses.

major_cooldowns.name: Fury of Elune
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it on the GCD before Force of Nature or lined up with your Eclipse entry and Incarnation, and never hold it far enough to lose a cast.

major_cooldowns.name: Force of Nature
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it while you are out of an Eclipse and your next button is Eclipse or Celestial Alignment/Incarnation, and hold it up to 15 seconds with Control of the Dream rather than breaking the lineup.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 205636 is the 60s summon; 205644 shares the name on an 8s cooldown. Not cast in the sampled parses, which all ran Elune's Chosen.

major_cooldowns.name: Incarnation: Chosen of Elune
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it right after Force of Nature, or when Lunar Eclipse will not reach 2 charges during the window, and open it with an instant Starfire to spend Ascendant Fires.

major_cooldowns.name: Celestial Alignment
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it outside an Eclipse right after Force of Nature or with Fury of Elune ready, and hold a charge for a mechanic only while you are not sitting on 2 charges.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 194223 is castable per its tooltip but was not pressed in the sampled parses, which all ran Incarnation: Chosen of Elune.

major_cooldowns.name: Convoke the Spirits
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Channel it below 40 Astral Power inside Celestial Alignment or Incarnation with Force of Nature active and Moonfire already on every target.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 391528 is the id the guide links; 323764 shares the name, and neither was cast in the sampled parses.

major_cooldowns.name: Wild Mushroom
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Drop it inside an Eclipse, or whenever its 3 charges would fill up before your next Celestial Alignment or Incarnation.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 88747 is the 30s 3-charge cast; 88751 shares the name as a passive. Not cast in the sampled parses.

defensives.name: Barkskin
defensives.usage_rule: Press it for any predictable raid damage; it is off the global so it never costs you a cast.

defensives.name: Survival Instincts
defensives.usage_rule: Save it for the single biggest hit you expect to eat, since the window is very short.
defensives.id_note: Castable per its tooltip but not pressed in the sampled parses.

defensives.name: Renewal
defensives.usage_rule: Press it the moment you drop low for an instant chunk of your health back.
defensives.id_note: 108238 is the long-standing cast id; 283762 shares the name. Neither was pressed in the sampled parses.

rules.description: Open with Moonfire, Sunfire, Eclipse, Incarnation
rules.action: Pre-cast your builder, apply both dots, enter Eclipse to start its cooldown, then send Incarnation.

rules.description: Keep Sunfire up on your target
rules.action: Refresh Sunfire inside its pandemic window, and reapply it the moment the pull is gathered.

rules.description: Keep Moonfire ticking on every target
rules.action: Spread Moonfire while the tank gathers and refresh it inside pandemic to keep Shooting Stars feeding.

rules.description: Starfire is your builder in Lunar Eclipse
rules.action: Generate with Starfire while Lunar Eclipse is up and save Wrath for Solar windows.

rules.description: Wrath is your builder in Solar Eclipse
rules.action: Generate with Wrath while Solar Eclipse is up and keep Starfire for Lunar and for instant casts.

rules.description: Overlap Eclipse with Fury of Elune
rules.action: Enter Eclipse in the same window as Fury of Elune, and hold either one only when it costs you no use.

rules.description: Spend Touch the Cosmos on Starfall or Starsurge
rules.action: Dump the free cast into Starfall, even in single target, or into Starsurge when you need to move.
Bank the proc into your next Eclipse entry, but fire the free Starsurge before it expires.
Bank the proc into your next Eclipse entry, but fire the free Starfall before it expires.

rules.description: Never cap Astral Power with Starfire
rules.action: Spend with Starsurge or Starfall before another builder wastes Astral Power, and use the instant spenders while you move.

source_summary: Balance treats Eclipse as a damage cooldown: press it with as much Astral Power as you can hold, never sit on 2 charges, and overlap every window with Force of Nature as Keeper of the Grove or Fury of Elune as Elune's Chosen. Celestial Alignment and Incarnation: Chosen of Elune follow a Force of Nature cast and are the windows where you spend hardest, opening with an instant Starfire to consume Ascendant Fires. Moonfire and Sunfire stay up on everything to feed Shooting Stars, and free Starfall and Starsurge procs get banked into an Eclipse entry rather than wasted.
